title: Lease runner API v2
description: Local HTTP (127.0.0.1, Bearer token). $defs holds the shape of each request, event and error. Adding a field does not bump the version. v2 does not depend on which agent runs the session: actions use generic kinds, quotas use generic time windows (quota.windows), and error codes do not name the implementation. Request bodies and responses carry "v": 2. v1 is retired; events stored before the change are sent as they are (v: 1).

mode.description: discuss = read-only discussion; work = may change this project's files and run commands, asking the user first every time (only for policy's work_projects)

session_id.description: This lease's session id (a UUID; the format the implementation requires)

attachments.description: Attachments: saved in that project's folder as attachments/<YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS>-<name> (file name cleaned, never overwritten, not in git); images (image/jpeg|png|gif|webp) are also shown to the model directly; a line with the saved path is appended to the text. Each at most 10 MB decoded; the whole request at most 100 MB.

message.description: POST /v1/leases/<id>/messages. At least one of text and attachments (with attachments only, text may be an empty string).

resumable.description: Whether this conversation can still be resumed (its transcript still exists)

event.description: Every event has these fields; the extra fields of each type are in tool_use_event, question_event, permission_event, state_event, quota, turn_end_event, error and file_event.

detail.description: A message for people; agent_login = the agent that runs the session is not logged in or its credentials expired (detail says which)

limit.description: too_many: at most this many idea sandboxes at once

current.description: too_many: how many there are now

no_session_domains.description: Domains (including subdomains) that open_web may not allow for the whole lease

work_projects.description: Projects that may use work mode (idea sandboxes whose settings already have the OS sandbox)

command.description: The command to resume this session in a terminal, shown as is (built by the runner for the implementation)

hint.description: One sentence for people: where to run it and what to do after

sandbox_create.description: POST /v1/sandboxes: open a project to explore an idea (read-only by default). Sending the same name and purpose again returns the same project (200) instead of opening a new one.

name.description: The idea's short name (readable, e.g. room-3d): lowercase letters, digits and -, not starting or ending with -, no --, at most 40 characters; must not collide with an existing project or folder (409 exists). Whether it is an idea sandbox is decided by the platform's registry, not by the name

sandbox.description: 201 (created) or 200 (already exists, resent). After that the name appears in policy's attachable and can be leased like any project. Errors: 400 bad_name, 409 exists (same name with a different purpose, or the name is taken by a real project), 429 too_many (with limit, current), 500 create_failed.

mode.description: POST /v1/leases/<id>/mode: switch a discussion between discuss and work midway (sent only after the user allowed hands-on work on the card). Success returns 200 + lease; 409 busy while answering or waiting for the user; 400 work_not_allowed if not in work_projects. Switching stops the process and resumes the same session; the permission relay starts over (domains allowed for the whole lease and file writes must be allowed again).

sandbox_upgrade.description: POST /v1/sandboxes/<name>/upgrade: upgrade an idea sandbox to a real project (history, files and memory are kept; a private GitHub repo is created). Sent only after the user agreed in the conversation. Sending again after an upgrade returns 200 + upgraded:false and the current name (safe to resend; found even after a rename).

sandbox_upgraded.description: 200. Errors: 404 not_found (no such sandbox), 409 not_idea (not an idea sandbox), 409 dirty (uncommitted changes), 409 name_taken (the new name or GitHub repo already exists), 500 upgrade_failed.

kind.description: What the action does: read, search (files or the web), ask_user (ask the user), open_web (open a web page), write_file (write a file), run_command (run a command), other

tool_use_event.description: type=tool_use: the session used a tool

summary.description: One sentence for people (e.g. read README.md)

detail.description: The implementation's own debugging information (e.g. the original tool name); readers must not depend on it

question_event.description: type=question: the session asks the user (and waits for the answer); phase=start when waiting begins, end with the result

target.description: The object being judged (URL, path, command)

decision.description: Only on end: allow / deny / answered / timeout and so on

permission_event.description: type=permission: what the session wants to do needs the user's consent; phase=start when waiting begins, end with the result

target.description: The object being judged (URL, path, command)

decision.description: Only on end: allow / deny / answered / timeout and so on

mode.description: Only when the mode changed (e.g. work back to discuss after the upgrade to a real project; detail says why)

resumed.description: Whether this start resumed the same conversation; false with a detail = it should have resumed but could not (the transcript is gone), so a new conversation started

project.description: The lease's project; after an upgrade with a rename, state events carry the new name (keep sending messages as usual; the runner resumes the same conversation in the new folder)

turn_end_event.description: type=turn_end: a turn ended (one with only summary is a progress summary midway)

quota.description: The content of a type=quota event, and the quota in /v1/status: the agent's usage windows. Readers display only by label and decide whether to warn only by used

file_event.description: type=file: the session shows the user a file from the project. Get the content with GET /v1/leases/<lease id>/files/<id> (same token; returns the file itself, Content-Type = mime; it is the copy made when it was shown, kept 30 days; 404 not_found if missing or expired). Types limited to png/jpg/webp/gif/pdf/glb/txt/md/json/csv (the content must match too), each ≤ 20 MB; only files in that lease's project folder, and nothing that looks like a credential

path.description: Path relative to the project folder

project_rename.description: POST /v1/projects/<name>/rename: rename a whole project (a real project or an idea sandbox): folder, memory, registration, GitHub repo (if any) and mirror move together, and the discussion's transcript moves with them. If that project has a discussion answering, waiting for a reply, open in a terminal or being reclaimed → 409 busy (nothing is touched; send again after that turn). An idle one is stopped first; after the move, leases not yet reclaimed get a state event with project: <new name>, and messages are sent as usual and resume the same conversation in the new folder. Errors: 400 bad_name, 404 not_found, 409 busy / name_taken (the new name, folder or GitHub repo already exists), 500 rename_failed. Sending the same rename again when it stopped halfway finishes it

to.description: The new name (lowercase letters, digits and -, at most 40 characters)

origin.description: The new remote URL; (native) when there is no remote
